name: MPRIS player fixes
description: Browser-player fixes for the compact, full and lock players: seek bars no longer pin at the end when a player (Firefox, Zen, YouTube tabs) reports no track length; Zen gets its own player icon (it shares Firefox's MPRIS bus name); and cover art falls back to the YouTube thumbnail from xesam:url when mpris:artUrl is empty.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Loads cover-art thumbnails from i.ytimg.com when a player provides no artwork
Reads ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/zen-browser.svg for the Zen player icon
